profile: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company developing RNA interference therapeutics, a class of medicines designed to silence messenger RNA involved in disease. The company has six marketed RNAi-based medicines, including products commercialized by collaborators, and conducts research and clinical development across multiple programs. Its medicines address diseases including transthyretin-mediated amyloidosis, acute hepatic porphyria, and primary hyperoxaluria, serving patients through its commercial and collaborator networks.
